_about: The maths misconception catalogue as released in v0.9.2, the release before decision 22, reduced to what the tests compare. `entries` is the LOADED catalogue (seed/generated/misconceptions.json): every id, its objective, kind, aliases and book-distractor maps, and a sha256 digest of what the loader writes from it (lo_id, label, description, signal, refutation). `retired_generator` is the same for build_misconceptions.py, the second source decision 22 retired: its kinds and aliases, which the database export had dropped, and the six t2u3-1-2 entries only it held. test_misconception_catalogue.py proves the single source keeps every live id serving unchanged and loses nothing the generator held (FR-4409). Regenerate only for a new release baseline, never to make a failing test pass.
generator: exported from the live comparison database — services/extraction/export_generated_content.py
